items.invariant: A transaction annotation or wrapper only protects calls that actually pass through its boundary.
items.applies_because: One public operation delegates to a second write method in the same service.
items.challenge: Trace the concrete call path and identify where rollback state is captured before the first write.

items.invariant: A two-step state change must not expose its first step when the second fails.
items.applies_because: The operation performs two dependent writes with an exception point between them.
items.challenge: Force the second step to fail and inspect durable state after the exception.

unknowns: This dependency-free case models proxy-based transaction entry; it does not load Spring itself.
